title: コーヒーこぼすな ～COFFEE WALK～
subtitle: 直線は急ぎ、危険の前で慎重に。
primary_input: two direction buttons and central pace button
duration_note: model comparison 29.25 seconds per mixed-policy delivery; human judgement and physical device timing unmeasured
primary_score: 1000 per nonempty delivered cup + 10 per remaining percent + 40 per spare second, integer floor each successful delivery
secondary_score: delivered cups, delivered remaining and spare time
escalation_mechanic: First180m delivery optionally starts another180m delivery with two cups. At most two simultaneous cups, same input.
risk_reward: Careful4m/s alone misses32s deadline; rush8m/s risks predicted step, corner and seam. Mixed policy can arrive with higher remaining and score.
visual_identity: slant top-down white ceramic cup with real handle, separately clipped coffee, thick wood tray, visible supporting palms/fingers/cuffs/teal sleeves and cafe-office corridor
storage_compatibility: Legacy best retained read-only; independent best-delivery-v2; original mute preference preserved
